decisions.reason: The Demeter yogurt is a flagship extension of an established range that fits the firm's biodynamic and organic positioning, and with industry turnover growing, results likely meet aspirations, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.

The mild sliced cheese is a low-cost extension of in-house cheesemaking that uses existing resources, and one year of market presence with its own product page gives no evidence of a shortfall, so slack allows the firm to keep it while results firm up.

The sliced butter cheese closely matches the established cheese offer and serves both retail and foodservice, so absent signs of performance below aspiration the firm would keep it rather than redirect resources.
